# Red Teamer engine dependencies.
#
# PyRIT is the external red-teaming framework — it is NEVER vendored into this repo; it is
# installed into a dedicated virtual environment (Python 3.12/3.13 recommended). The adapter
# (a365_target.py) reuses the Prompts Sender engine, hence msal + requests are also required.
pyrit==1.1.0
msal>=1.28
requests>=2.31
